1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

4212|f099e750.name: Telonis
4212|f099e750.text: Do not try to force your will upon the leather. Rather, let its natural tendencies dictate what form and function it will take. This is not a battle to be won. Work with the leather, not against it.

5127|0850acfb.name: Fimble Finespindle
5127|0850acfb.text: Nope, can't help you, I'm afraid. Your skills have mine beat! If you want to learn more, talk to the night elf Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He's amazing!

5166|b0da17d0.name: Ormyr Flinteye
5166|b0da17d0.text: I got something for you, $N. Looks important.

5167|b0da17d0.name: Fenthwick
5167|b0da17d0.text: I got something for you, $N. Looks important.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

115-complete.name: Marshal Marris
115-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  I'll send these to be destroyed immediately.
115-complete.title: Shadow Magic

115-progress.name: Marshal Marris
115-progress.text: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters?  Did you find the midnight orbs?
115-progress.title: Shadow Magic

1241-accept.name: Bishop DeLavey
1241-accept.text:
Recently a diplomat was sent to Theramore to meet with Jaina Proudmoore. That diplomat never arrived.

I believe the Defias are involved in this plot, but I'm not sure how. The diplomat's disappearance still eludes public attention, but it can't remain that way for long.

Agents of the king are already scouring the city for clues, but I have my own contacts I would like involved.

In the Valley of Heroes is an old friend of mine named Jorgen. Find him, give him this note, and follow his instructions.
1241-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1241-complete.name: Jorgen
1241-complete.text:
Hmm... <Jorgen looks up at you through squinted eyes.>

All right. I'll help ya, but not because I want to, but because I'm obligated.

And let's get one thing straight: you're knowin' far more than you should to begin with. Let's keep this our little secret, and don't go blabbin' at any taverns about anything you find out. Understand?
1241-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1241-progress.name: Jorgen
1241-progress.text: Hmph, you better have good reason to interrupt a man and his fishin'. I don't take kindly to peddlers, let alone beggars.
1241-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1242-accept.name: Jorgen
1242-accept.text:
Take this here note to Elling Trias. Don't say nothin' else to him. Just be polite and wait for him to respond. And don't worry, he will.

I'm gonna only impress this on ya once more, $N: treat this matter seriously, and keep your yapper shut.

Ya can find Trias at his cheese shop, Trias' Cheese, in the Trade District. Good luck.
1242-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1242-complete.name: Elling Trias
1242-complete.text:
I'm sorry, a letter for me? Well, I'll be... not often you get a delivery that's not a crate or barrel when all you do is work. Let's see what this is about.

<Elling looks up at you while he opens the letter.>

You look a little tense, you okay, $N?
1242-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1242-progress.name: Elling Trias
1242-progress.text: Hello, $N. Is there something I can do for you? Perhaps you'd like to try some of our special Trias cheddar? Or a block of Darnassian bleu?
1242-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1243-accept.name: Elling Trias
1243-accept.text:
Jorgen, you ol' sonuva.... So, that's how it's going to be, huh?

All right, I can deal with that. I hope he finds the Twisting Nether that much sooner!

Here's what's gonna happen, $N. I'll start using my contacts here, but you're doing most of the footwork so I save some coin.

Head to Darkshire in Duskwood and find Watcher Backus--he usually patrols the north road right outside of town. Just tell him you're looking into any Defias activity for me and he'll help you out with any information he can.
1243-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1243-complete.name: Watcher Backus
1243-complete.text:
Oh, Trias sent you, huh? That's a little different.

Feel free to fight whatever monstrosities come at you from the darkness. I'm sure you'll be able to handle it pretty easily if you're the type to be hanging around with the likes of him.

So, what does my friend need of me on such a gloomy day as this?
1243-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1243-progress.name: Watcher Backus
1243-progress.text:
Not too safe to be traveling about in the woods, $N. Be careful, and if you see anything suspicious or dangerous, contact the Watchers immediately. Don't try and take anything on yourself. We're not responsible for anything terrible that might happen to you.

But we both know you're gonna ignore me and fight whatever comes out of the darkness anyway, don't we? Haha, yeah, you adventurer types... all the same.
1243-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1244-accept.name: Watcher Backus
1244-accept.text:
Defias activity? Well, there's always some activity; even if they keep to themselves we consider them a threat.

But now that I think about it, there was a recent sighting that seemed odd. It must have been a couple weeks ago, but some of their agents had gathered around Addle's Stead. From the report, I'd guessed something big went down.

Why don't you check there first and bring me back anything you find?

The farmstead is south of the road from Westfall just as you enter Duskwood.
1244-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1244-complete.name: Watcher Backus
1244-complete.text:
You're back safe and sound. Couldn't ask for much more than that, could you?

Now, let's see what we have here. This looks pretty official as far as any Defias documents I've seen. But it could be a dupe just to throw you off track of whatever it is you're looking for.
1244-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1244-progress.name: Watcher Backus
1244-progress.text: Be careful out there, $N. I know Trias was the one to send you here, but that doesn't mean there isn't anything lurking out in the woods that couldn't cause you some trouble... especially with you investigating the Defias.
1244-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1245-accept.name: Watcher Backus
1245-accept.text:
Whoa, this looks way too complex to be something to just lead you astray. I shouldn't even be looking at this stuff. Take it to Trias--he'll be able to make sense of it. And DON'T let anyone get in your way. This is bigger than me. It might even be bigger than him, but we'll see.

And do me a favor, $N, don't tell anyone I helped you. If my superiors found out I knew about any of this and didn't share it with them they'd probably hang me.
1245-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

126-complete.name: Verner Osgood
126-complete.text: Again, thank you for your help.  The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
126-complete.title: Howling in the Hills

126-progress.name: Verner Osgood
126-progress.text: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N.  If you're not ready for him, I understand.
126-progress.title: Howling in the Hills

1274-accept.name: Thomas
1274-accept.text:
Excuse me, sir. Bishop DeLavey asked me to approach adventurers that might be able to help him with a delicate matter.

If you could quietly head to Stormwind Keep and speak to him at your earliest convenience, I'm sure he would appreciate your help. Again, please be discreet. It is a matter of some importance.
1274-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1274-complete.name: Bishop DeLavey
1274-complete.text:
Hello, $N. I am Bishop DeLavey.

No doubt if you're asking me about my business here in the keep then young Thomas has succeeded in requisitioning you to help our kingdom. He has always been adept at following my requests.

I'm afraid I don't have time to elaborate much, so allow me to be blunt... and please, try to keep this from becoming common knowledge.
1274-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

133-complete.name: Abercrombie
133-complete.text: Ah, thanks.  These will do just the trick!
133-complete.title: Ghoulish Effigy

133-progress.name: Abercrombie
133-progress.text: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick!  Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?
133-progress.title: Ghoulish Effigy

134-accept.name: Abercrombie
134-accept.text:
A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me!  I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.

After they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood.  I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.

Please, $N, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.
134-accept.title: Ogre Thieves

134-complete.name: Abercrombie
134-complete.text:
Thank the Nec-...well, thank YOU, $N!  You have more than earned your reward.

Aha!  Happy!  Happy nights ahead!!
134-complete.title: Ogre Thieves

134-progress.name: Abercrombie
134-progress.text: Do you have my crate?  If so, then please...give it to me quickly!
134-progress.title: Ogre Thieves

160-accept.name: Abercrombie
160-accept.text:
Take this note to Ello Ebonlocke, the Mayor of Darkshire.

He and I are old friends...and when he reads it and discovers what you did for me...I'm sure he'll be just as happy as I am!  Hahahaha!
160-accept.title: Note to the Mayor

160-complete.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
160-complete.text:
<Ello looks at the letter...>

What language is this?  It looks ancient...I can't read it.
160-complete.title: Note to the Mayor

160-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
160-progress.text:
Abercrombie...?  I don't know a person of that name.  You say you have a letter for me from this Abercrombie fellow?

Well let's have it then...
160-progress.title: Note to the Mayor

169-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
169-complete.text: Fantastic work, $N!  Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans.  Vindication is ours.  This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of Stormwind!
169-complete.title: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg

173-complete.name: Calor
173-complete.text:
Impressive, $N. It would seem that you are capable enough to handle yourself. Perhaps a more suitable challenge could be found for one of your abilities.

It is curious though... The worgen seemed to just appear out of thin air. But then, with all the other strange creatures that have moved across our borders, I suppose it's only one of many concerns.
173-complete.title: Worgen in the Woods

19-complete.name: Marshal Marris
19-complete.text: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc.  Well done--I'm sure he didn't go down easy.  Here is your reward, $N.
19-complete.title: Tharil'zun

19-progress.name: Marshal Marris
19-progress.text: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense.  But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
19-progress.title: Tharil'zun

221-accept.name: Calor
221-accept.text:
You might have noticed some larger worgen wandering around with the Shadow Weavers in the woods? From what we can tell, these Dark Runners make up the bulk of the worgen numbers.

On my rangings, I've also noticed that they have overrun the Rotting Orchard southwest of town. These worgen are a bit tougher than the last you faced.

Be on your guard.
221-accept.title: Worgen in the Woods

225-accept.name: Unknown
225-accept.text:
The weathered grave marker reads simply:

MORGAN LADIMORE

<Upon further examination, you notice that dirt over the grave has been recently disturbed, and that a good amount of the dirt seems to have been displaced...>
225-accept.title: The Weathered Grave

225-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
225-complete.text:
Morgan Ladimore?

Ahh, yes, of course. His was a long and sorrowful tale. I knew him, well, before he left for the war, but that was the last time I saw him. A noble and good man, he was, but he suffered a bad end.

Here, I should have something here that can tell the tale better than my own recollections...
225-complete.title: The Weathered Grave

227-accept.name: Sirra Von'Indi
227-accept.text:
<He searches through the shelves and comes up with a leatherbound book.>

If you would like to know more, you might ask Althea, she's been the one to handle the... trouble... with him of late.
227-accept.title: Morgan Ladimore

227-complete.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
227-complete.text:
Morgan Ladimore? Never heard of...

Oh, you mean Mor'Ladim! I guess you haven't heard the story?

Well, I'll give you the short version. A wandering undead calling itself Mor'Ladim has been wandering Duskwood. From what we've gathered, it appears to be the undead body of Morgan Ladimore, of whom you apparently know. He's been causing us all sorts of problems, attacking Watchmen on patrol and killing people.

<She sizes you up.>

You seem to be capable enough, maybe you could lay him to rest.
227-complete.title: Morgan Ladimore

228-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
228-accept.text:
From what my scouts tell me, Mor'Ladim wanders throughout Duskwood, following a strange and meandering path through the cemetery. We buried him out past the house on the hill, you know where that is?

There isn't anything I can do to help you, but I wish you good luck.
228-accept.title: Mor'Ladim

228-progress.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
228-progress.text: I don't blame you if you're having trouble with him, $N. Some of our strongest Watchers have been lost to Mor'Ladim.
228-progress.title: Mor'Ladim

251-accept.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
251-accept.text: Take the note you gave me to Sirra Von'Indi.  He's very learned in languages and ancient arts - if anyone here can translate this message, it's he.
251-accept.title: Translate Abercrombie's Note

251-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
251-progress.text: A note from Abercrombie the hermit, eh?  I don't know him, though if he lives out at the graveyard then I do know his brains have rotted out!
251-progress.title: Translate Abercrombie's Note

252-accept.name: Sirra Von'Indi
252-accept.text:
Oh my!  If what is written on this note is true, then Abercrombie's done something...unspeakable.

You better bring the translated note back to Ello.

And do so quickly, for I fear a doom already lumbers toward our town...
252-accept.title: Translation to Ello

252-complete.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
252-complete.text:
<Ello reads the letter...and his face goes white.  He then looks at you...>

Although the aid you gave Abercrombie may have been motivated from kindness, your actions have doomed our town.

<Ello becomes lost in his thoughts...>
252-complete.title: Translation to Ello

252-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
252-progress.text: Ah, is the note translated?  Please, let me see it...
252-progress.title: Translation to Ello

253-accept.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
253-accept.text:
The Embalmer is a name told in one of our children's stories.  He was a kindly alchemist, driven mad by the death of his wife, Eliza.  To restore her, he used dark magic to place his own heart within the bosom of his dead spouse.

This revived Eliza...but it cursed her with a hunger for $r flesh, forcing the Embalmer to keep her buried.

His heart is his power.  Find his wife's grave, retrieve his heart, and bring it to me while it still beats.  Do this and his power will be broken.
253-accept.title: Bride of the Embalmer

269-accept.name: Sven Yorgen
269-accept.text:
Go to the city of Stormwind and speak with Bishop Farthing in the Cathedral of Light.  Give him Jitters' journal and tell him you mean to face Morbent Fel.

Although Stormwind has forsaken Darkshire, Farthing is a kind soul and very wise.  He may help you on your quest to save us.

Your mission is perilous, but hurry, $N.  With each passing hour, the shadows of Duskwood grow ever darker.
269-accept.title: Seeking Wisdom

275-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
275-complete.text: This land is soothed by your efforts, and for this I will grant you a boon.
275-complete.title: Blisters on the Land

289-complete.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
289-complete.text: My thanks to you, $N. And the gratitude of my cursed brethren goes to you as well.
289-complete.title: The Cursed Crew

289-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
289-progress.text: In my dreams, I can sometimes hear the doomed moans of my brethren! Please, good sir, free them from the bonds and quiet their cries.
289-progress.title: The Cursed Crew

290-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
290-accept.text:
To break the curse and free all of my brethren, the...thing...stowed on my ship must be retrieved and cleansed! I don't know what it was, but I do know that it was stored securely in the ship's strongbox, which Captain Halyndor lorded over.

My old captain is still in my dreams. I know he walks my doomed ship, the Intrepid. Get the key from him, and use it to open the Intrepid's strongbox.

Then, after you have the cursed thing, bring it to the priest Glorin Steelbrow in town.
290-accept.title: Lifting the Curse

323-complete.name: Sven Yorgen
323-complete.text: Your skill in combat, $N, can not be doubted.  Your resolve may yet see us through to the end of Morbent Fel!
323-complete.title: Proving Your Worth

337-complete.name: Milton Sheaf
337-complete.text:
Oh my!  This book hasn't rested on these shelves since before the rebuilding of Stormwind, years ago.  It will have to be restored of course, it's in bad shape, but I would be honored to place it within our rare books collection.

Thank you, sir.  Please accept this as payment for returning the book!
337-complete.title: An Old History Book

337-progress.name: Milton Sheaf
337-progress.text: Ooh!  What's that old book you have there?  Can I see it??
337-progress.title: An Old History Book

401-accept.name: Sirra Von'Indi
401-accept.text: I'm almost finished translating that note.  If you come back in a few moments I should be done.
401-accept.title: Wait for Sirra to Finish

401-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
401-complete.text:
There we are.  It's translated...

<The air grows heavy, as if a thick, black curtain is drawn over the land...>
401-complete.title: Wait for Sirra to Finish

471-complete.name: James Halloran
471-complete.text:
Hmm... Don't suppose you'd be interested in becoming my apprentice, would you?

Hah! No, I'm just kidding. You're much too old, for one thing. Besides - from the looks of you, it would seem that you have other ambitions in life. Nonetheless, these are some fine skins you've procured, and I'll be able to put them to good use.
471-complete.title: Apprentice's Duties

471-progress.name: James Halloran
471-progress.text:
My apprentice is like a son to me. It's going to be hard for him to live his life with only one leg.

Ah, $N, how goes it?  Do you have my skins?
471-progress.title: Apprentice's Duties

538-accept.name: Milton Sheaf
538-accept.text:
$N.  If you don't mind a long journey then I have a task for you, to again help Stormwind fill its library.

The old kingdom of Alterac fell after the great war, and it had a large collection of books.  It's a tragedy that the city is ruined, but even more tragic is all of their knowledge lost!  We must recover what we can.

Southshore is the closest town to the Ruins of Alterac.  Go there and speak with Loremaster Dibbs.  He can direct you to the ruins, and to what books may be found there.
538-accept.title: Southshore

58-complete.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
58-complete.text: On behalf of the people of Darkshire and as the Leader of the Night Watch, I thank you, $N, for your bravery and dedication.  May the Light shine upon your ways.
58-complete.title: The Night Watch

68-accept.name: Unknown
68-accept.text: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.
68-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

971-accept.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
971-accept.text:
As you might know, I collect lore.  Old lore.  Powerful lore.  Lore that opens doorways, and lore that can awaken Those Who Sleep.

There are rumors of an old piece of lore, the Lorgalis Manuscript, at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale.  That place is the old dwelling of long-dead elves.  Elves who held great knowledge before their city fell to ruin.

Search Blackfathom Deeps for the manuscript.  Do this, and I will not forget it.  Not even after ... the end days.
971-accept.title: Knowledge in the Deeps

98245-progress.name: Howin Kindfeather
98245-progress.text: Any luck prying those teeth off? I need 'em whole so they don't snap on the scales right away.
98245-progress.title: Razormaw Needling

98246-progress.name: Howin Kindfeather
98246-progress.text: The Razormaw won't be none too happy about you taking their eggs, so be ready for a squabble.
98246-progress.title: Trying Times
